base_member_text: [L120-L123] (LOW/diagnostics) The preprocessing failure message says 'Fortran does do preprocessing', which is grammatically incorrect and obscures the intended configure failure reason.
audit_member_text: [L122] (LOW/diagnostic) The failure diagnostic says Fortran does do preprocessing when detection has failed.

base_member_text: [L220-L231] (MED/configure-cache) AX_FC_HAS_MODULE uses the single cache key ax_cv_fc_has_module for every module argument, so the result of the first module probe can be incorrectly reused for later different modules.
audit_member_text: [L221-L231] (MED/cache-key) All module names share ax_cv_fc_has_module, so subsequent module checks reuse the first module's result.

adversarial.rationale: The macro really caches every argument under ax_cv_fc_has_module and never invalidates it, so different module probes can reuse the first result. A source-tree search found no AX_FC_HAS_MODULE invocation: this is a latent reusable-macro defect, not an active XBeach configure failure, and requires introducing multiple calls without clearing that cache.
adversarial.verified_by: llm:codex gpt-6-astra skeptic + caller verbatim neutralizer re-check

base_member_text: [L233-L236] (MED/configure-conditional) The macro defines HAVE_$1 via AC_DEFINE but tests the shell variable HAVE_$1 in AM_CONDITIONAL without assigning it, so the generated conditional can remain false even when the module probe succeeds.
audit_member_text: [L218,L233-L236] (MED/output-contract) The module check defines a preprocessor symbol but never assigns the shell variable used by AM_CONDITIONAL or the documented FC_HAS_MODULE output.

adversarial.rationale: AC_DEFINE does not assign a shell variable, and neither HAVE_$1 nor the documented FC_HAS_MODULE output is assigned anywhere in this macro. No caller of AX_FC_HAS_MODULE exists in the supplied tree, so the broken output/conditional contract is latent and becomes observable only if the macro is used.
adversarial.verified_by: llm:codex gpt-6-astra skeptic + caller verbatim neutralizer re-check

audit_member_text: [L31,L50,L164,L183] (MED/cache-key) The repeatable line-length macros share one cache entry per language across different requested lengths and source formats.
dispositions.rationale: span-confirmed: Both macros use repeatable AC_DEFUN despite their DEFUN_ONCE comments, and each language uses a single fixed cache key regardless of requested length or source format. A later invocation therefore reuses the earlier cached flag instead of testing its new requirement.

audit_member_text: [L104-L115] (MED/feature-probe) The preprocessing test contains no code that requires preprocessing, allowing compilers that ignore directives and unknown options to produce a false positive.
